title: Patient Financial Account Terms — Credit Kept for Linden Membership Dues
content:
**Term.** For a patient with an active membership under Linden Memberships billed monthly, one period's dues amount is kept from a credit on the Patient Financial Account for the next dues bill. For an active membership billed annually whose current period started at least 11 calendar months before the handling date, one twelfth of its dues amount is kept. Otherwise nothing is kept for dues.

What is kept stays on the account as a credit and is not refunded.

**Records read (Linden Memberships).** The membership's status, its billing cycle (monthly or annual), its dues amount, and the start date of its current period.

**Counting months.** A window of calendar months for the credit refund ends on the handling date and reaches back that many months, a date on the same calendar day that many months earlier falling outside it. A current period that started on the same calendar day 11 months before the handling date started at least 11 months before it.

| Linden Memberships record | Kept for dues |
|---|---|
| active, billed monthly | one period's dues amount |
| active, billed annually, current period started 11 or more calendar months before the handling date | one twelfth of the dues amount |
| active, billed annually, current period started fewer than 11 months before | nothing |
| no active membership | nothing |

**Hypothetical figures.** Monthly dues of 89.00: 89.00 is kept. Annual dues of 1,800.00 with the current period started 11 months ago: one twelfth, 150.00, is kept; started 10 months ago: nothing is kept.
